direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; cols 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Refit the evidence inspector so its selected-row outline stays inside the 360px panel without clipping the scrollbar or card text at 1366x768.
Enlarge SVG option-card and evidence labels below 11px to 11px and raise silverDim contrast on the dark stage.
Keep the header logo and this opening-story logo as the only two placements; reduce the story logo height slightly to give the 70 / 2 / 36h metrics more breathing room.
Keep ROUTE HEALTH · PRE-FLIGHT, including nonce and identity checks, as a separate labelled group above INVESTIGATION · SOURCE EVIDENCE, with its own status line so the two controls are never merged.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to the route select and ensure arrow-key and Enter/Space behaviour is announced in the guide strip.
Tighten the lower Britannia strip spacing so the legend row sits fully clear of the stage border at 768px height.
Preserve selection-opens-consent behaviour; keep the typed APPROVE field, exact-phrase hint and disabled-until-match Accept grouped as one form with aria-describedby.
Prevent the guide subtitle from wrapping under the header; refit to one line by shortening copy before reducing type.
Make the selected-path marker pattern plus text, not colour alone, and keep only the action-bar primary in neon fill.
Refit the proposal panel so tasks 1-3, status chips and Approve/Decline controls fit without nested scroll trapping; keep PROPOSED · UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on every task.
Remove the duplicate primary emphasis between the inspector Approve button and the action-bar Approve button; leave one neon primary per viewport.
Enlarge the small proposal meta text to 11px minimum and give the 1/2/3 task targets a clear focus ring.
Keep the CELL-MILL-2 preview dashed and labelled PREVIEW until applied; do not use stoppedRed until the shock is actually applied.
Add focus ring and pointer style only to the enabled machine select and Apply control, with the invalidation consequence in aria-live text.
Refit the right panel so Scenario management is separated from Cell availability with a divider and 36px minimum target.
Preserve stoppedRed exclusively on CELL-MILL-2 with STOPPED, OFFLINE-STOPPED and cross-hatch; verify no feasible route traces through it.
Keep pre-flight nonce/identity health visually distinct from the not-yet-run investigation evidence task, as in Step 2.
Raise the constrained Split card text contrast while retaining hatch plus text so meaning survives reduced motion and monochrome.
Keep the revised typed consent form tied to the selected feasible path, with prior-acceptance-invalidated status centred in the action bar and Accept disabled until exact match.
Ensure the constrained Split path shows finish and cost as unavailable with text, not faint dashes alone.
Refit inspector cards to avoid the bottom consent hint touching the action bar at 768px height.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks in their own collapsed-but-visible group, separate from the 3 PROPOSED replacements, while the approved revised plan status remains in the action bar.
Refit the board so both groups and Approve/Decline fit the inspector without double nested scrollbars; allow one internal scroll region only.
Label replacement tasks UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on each card and enlarge blocked-group text to 11px minimum.
Sequence Verify ledger, Seal encrypted packet and Retain independent checkpoint as numbered, state-gated controls with disabled reasons in text.
Keep the separate export passphrase field distinct from the consent phrase, with its length checklist linked via aria-describedby and a focus ring.
Refit the Before-After metrics so 70 / 35h / 48h align on one baseline and do not crowd the stage title.
Keep the completion state in the action bar as status text only, with no extra primary, and retain Back as the sole action.
Ensure the sealed-packet summary names the revised accepted plan and retained offline CELL-MILL-2 state, matching the SVG.
Confirm no third logo placement appears on the completion screen and the rail complete marker uses check plus text, not colour alone.
